_note: The forms people meet, per drug, in plain words (writing rules: 'Photos'). Each line restates the drug's sourced form records in data/identity/ (the ids in src are that record's own sources, shown as links); 'photos' are ids in photos.json. A form with no free photo yet shows its symbol.

2c-x.name: Tablets
2c-x.what: Pressed pills. 2C-B pills have been sold as MDMA or LSD.

2c-x.name: Blotter and liquid
2c-x.what: 2C-I has also been found on small paper squares and as a liquid.

5-meo-dmt.name: Powder and liquid
5-meo-dmt.what: Seized as a powder and as a liquid.

5-meo-dmt.name: A natural source
5-meo-dmt.what: It is also found in some toads and plants.

alcohol.name: Drinks
alcohol.what: Beer, wine, cider and spirits, and fortified wines such as sherry and port.

alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.name: Poppers
alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.what: Small bottles with names, often sold as 'room odouriser' or 'leather cleaner'. They usually contain butyl or isobutyl nitrite.

alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.name: Aerosols and sprays
alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.what: Spray deodorants, air fresheners, hair spray, spray paint and other sprays.

alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.name: Gases
alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.what: Lighter refills, butane and propane gas, and gas cylinders.

alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.name: Glues and solvents
alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.what: Glue, paint thinner, correction fluid, marker pens, cleaning fluids and petrol.

alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.name: As a medicine
alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.what: Amyl nitrite is also a medicine: an antidote to cyanide.

amphetamine.name: Powder
amphetamine.what: Most street amphetamine is a white or off-white powder.

amphetamine.name: Tablets
amphetamine.what: Pills, sometimes with logos like ecstasy pills.

benzodiazepines.name: Medicines
benzodiazepines.what: Mostly tablets and capsules; some liquids and injections.

benzodiazepines.name: Fake pills
benzodiazepines.what: Tablets made to look like Xanax, Valium or Klonopin, sometimes in blister packs, with another benzodiazepine inside.

benzodiazepines.name: Powders, blotters and liquids
benzodiazepines.what: New benzodiazepines sold online as 'research chemicals': powders, tablets, capsules, blotters and liquids for vapes.

caffeine.name: Pure caffeine
caffeine.what: Very concentrated caffeine, sold in bulk as a powder or a liquid.

cannabis.name: Dried flower (weed)
cannabis.what: The dried flowering tops and leaves of the cannabis plant.

cannabis.name: Hash (resin)
cannabis.what: A pressed solid made from the resin of the plant.

cannabis.name: Oil (hash oil)
cannabis.what: A thick, dark oil extracted from the plant.

cannabis.name: Medicines
cannabis.what: Prescription cannabis and medicines with THC or CBD, in some countries.

cocaine.name: Powder
cocaine.what: A white, crystalline powder made from the leaves of the coca plant.

cocaine.name: Crack (rocks)
cocaine.what: Cocaine base, in small white lumps called rocks.

dmt-ayahuasca.name: Ayahuasca (a brew)
dmt-ayahuasca.what: A drink brewed from an Amazonian plant that contains DMT, together with a vine.

dmt-ayahuasca.name: Made in labs
dmt-ayahuasca.what: DMT is also made in labs; it is seized in solid and liquid form.

dmt-ayahuasca.name: Snuffs and plants
dmt-ayahuasca.what: South American snuffs and plant material.

dxm.name: Cough and cold medicines
dxm.what: In more than 120 over-the-counter cold medicines, alone or mixed with other drugs.

fentanyl-and-analogues.name: Fake pills
fentanyl-and-analogues.what: Counterfeit pills made to look like prescription medicines.

fentanyl-and-analogues.name: Powder
fentanyl-and-analogues.what: A white granular or crystalline powder.

fentanyl-and-analogues.name: Medicines
fentanyl-and-analogues.what: Skin patches, lozenges, tablets for the mouth and injections.

fentanyl-and-analogues.name: Blotter paper
fentanyl-and-analogues.what: Fentanyl has also been found on blotter paper.

ghb-gbl.name: Clear liquid
ghb-gbl.what: GHB is usually a clear, colourless liquid. GBL and 1,4-butanediol are related chemicals.

ghb-gbl.name: Powder
ghb-gbl.what: Rarely, a white powder, loose or in capsules.

ghb-gbl.name: As a medicine
ghb-gbl.what: Sodium oxybate (Xyrem in the US) is a prescription medicine.

heroin.name: Brown powder
heroin.what: The more common form, from south-west Asia.

ketamine.name: Powder and crystals
ketamine.what: A white crystalline powder; most ketamine seized in the EU is powder.

ketamine.name: Liquid in small vials
ketamine.what: As a medicine and a vet medicine; illegal ketamine is also found as a liquid.

ketamine.name: In pills and mixtures
ketamine.what: Sometimes in pills sold as ecstasy, or mixed with stimulants, as in 'pink cocaine'.

kratom.name: Green powder
kratom.what: Powdered dried leaves of a tropical tree from Southeast Asia.

kratom.name: Leaves
kratom.what: Fresh or dried leaves, whole or crushed.

kratom.name: Capsules and tablets
kratom.what: Powdered kratom in capsules or tablets.

kratom.name: Extracts and resin
kratom.what: Pastes, a dark brown resin and tinctures made from the leaves.

kratom.name: Tea and drinks
kratom.what: Tea from the leaves, and local drinks in Thailand and Malaysia.

lsd.name: Blotters
lsd.what: Small squares of absorbent paper, often printed with designs.

lsd.name: Liquid
lsd.what: LSD dissolved in water or alcohol.

lsd.name: Sugar cubes and capsules
lsd.what: Sugar cubes soaked in it, and capsules.

mdma.name: Pills (ecstasy)
mdma.what: Pressed tablets, often with a logo.

mdma.name: Crystals and powder
mdma.what: White or off-white crystals or powder.

mescaline.name: Peyote cactus
mescaline.what: A small, spineless cactus; mescaline is its main ingredient.

mescaline.name: Buttons
mescaline.what: The tops of the cactus, fresh or dried.

mescaline.name: Powder and capsules
mescaline.what: Dried buttons ground into powder, in capsules.

methadone-buprenorphine.name: Methadone
methadone-buprenorphine.what: A liquid (oral solution), tablets, and an injection: the medicine most often prescribed in opioid treatment in Europe.

methadone-buprenorphine.name: Buprenorphine
methadone-buprenorphine.what: Tablets and films that dissolve under the tongue (some with naloxone), long-acting injections, implants and skin patches.

methamphetamine.name: Crystal ('ice')
methamphetamine.what: Crystals of the pure drug, known as 'ice' or 'crystal meth'.

methamphetamine.name: Powder
methamphetamine.what: Most of what is sold is powder, often mixed with other ingredients.

methamphetamine.name: Tablets
methamphetamine.what: Pills, sometimes with logos like ecstasy pills.

methamphetamine.name: As a medicine
methamphetamine.what: Desoxyn tablets, a prescription medicine in the US.

methylphenidate.name: Prescription medicines
methylphenidate.what: Tablets and capsules such as Ritalin and Concerta.

nicotine.name: Cigarettes, cigars and pipes
nicotine.what: Tobacco: factory-made or hand-rolled cigarettes, cigars and pipes.

nicotine.name: Vapes (e-cigarettes)
nicotine.what: Electronic devices with a liquid that may contain nicotine and flavourings.

nicotine.name: Nicotine pouches
nicotine.what: Look like snus but usually have no tobacco: nicotine with flavourings.

nicotine.name: Nicotine replacement
nicotine.what: Nicotine as a medicine to help people stop smoking.

nitrous-oxide.name: Small chargers
nitrous-oxide.what: Small metal cartridges of 8 grams, also called whippets.

nitrous-oxide.name: Large cylinders
nitrous-oxide.what: Bigger cylinders, from about half a kilo to 15 kilos.

nitrous-oxide.name: Other uses
nitrous-oxide.what: A medical gas, always given with oxygen, and the gas in whipped-cream cans.

pcp.name: Powder, crystals, tablets, capsules or liquid
pcp.what: It can range from a powder to a sticky mass.

prescription-opioids.name: Tablets and capsules
prescription-opioids.what: Oxycodone, morphine, codeine, tramadol and others, in many colours and markings.

prescription-opioids.name: Mixed with paracetamol
prescription-opioids.what: Hydrocodone, oxycodone and codeine combined with paracetamol (acetaminophen) or aspirin.

prescription-opioids.name: Liquids
prescription-opioids.what: Morphine oral solutions and codeine cough medicines.

psilocybin.name: Dried mushrooms
psilocybin.what: Dried mushrooms; more than 50 species contain psilocybin.

psilocybin.name: Powders and capsules
psilocybin.what: Dried mushrooms ground into powder, or in capsules.

psilocybin.name: In tea or food
psilocybin.what: Mushrooms made into tea or added to food.

salvia-divinorum.name: Leaves
salvia-divinorum.what: Fresh or dried leaves of a plant in the mint family.

salvia-divinorum.name: Extract-enhanced leaves
salvia-divinorum.what: Dried leaves strengthened with extract, sold as '5x' to '50x'.

salvia-divinorum.name: Extracts and tinctures
salvia-divinorum.what: Liquid extracts made from the leaves.

synthetic-cannabinoids.name: Herbal mixes in packets
synthetic-cannabinoids.what: Dried plant material sprayed with the chemicals, sold in foil packets with brand names, or as 'incense'.

synthetic-cannabinoids.name: Liquids for vapes
synthetic-cannabinoids.what: Liquids made to be used in electronic cigarettes.

synthetic-cannabinoids.name: Paper and cards
synthetic-cannabinoids.what: Paper or cards soaked in the chemicals.

synthetic-cathinones.name: Powders and crystals
synthetic-cathinones.what: White or brown powders or crystals, often sold as 'bath salts', 'plant food' or 'research chemicals'.

synthetic-cathinones.name: Capsules and tablets
synthetic-cathinones.what: Less often, capsules or tablets, some with logos.

synthetic-cathinones.name: Khat
synthetic-cathinones.what: Fresh leaves and shoots of a shrub, usually in bundles wrapped in banana leaves. It contains cathinone.
